definition: Dollar markdown as a fraction of the markdown prior price. Also called discount or just markdown.
Total dollar markdown divided by total markdown prior price. Also called avg markdown or avg discount.
The ratio of units sold and starting inventory.
The ratio of total units sold and total starting inventory.
The ratio of GMV and IRV.
The ratio of total GMV to total IRV.
Total weighted markdown percent divided by the total starting inventory. Also called wt. avg. discount or wt. avg. markdown.
The 'X'th percentile of markdown percent, where 'X' is a number between 0 and 100. Also called 'X'th percentile markdown or discount.
avg RR, avg STR, wt. avg. discount, p10 discount, p90 discount, number of items, number of stores, total starting inventory, total markdown spend, total GMV and total units sold
